provenance.method: UAssetAPI decoded Blueprint expressions + exact Kismet VM offsets + serialized World table

baseline.stage: MainLevel startup loading chain complete, before optional tutorial/story/challenge/boss events
baseline.visibilityMeaning: level load/visibility policy only; individual actors may hide/activate through Blueprint
baseline.notPermanentClaim: district startup loads proven; DynamicProps is later reset and actor visibility can change

transitionOverlay.completionRelation: independent latent branch; no claim that this waits for all city sublevels

conditionalLevels.stage: after DynamicProps completion, before loading-finished widgets

eventContracts.automaticStartCondition: HeroGameMode.GameStartEvent: NOT SaveData.IsFirstTutorial; ForceStartTutorial is also an explicit entry
eventContracts.unknown: saved flag initial value and current user save state are not assumed

eventContracts.entryGuard: own QuestType == CQType AND own QuestDifficulty == CQDifficulty
eventContracts.mainWorldTransition: StartCQEvent -> LoadingNow=true -> unload selected level -> completion -> unload selected level again -> completion -> load selected level visible=true/block=false
eventContracts.nonMainWorldTransition: IsMainLevel=false selects DPropTest for QuestType=0, FPropTest for QuestType=1; not part of MainLevel baseline
eventContracts.unknown: EndCQEvent/Restart/result-screen animation ordering and all reset side effects are preserved in AST, not fully converted to an executable event graph
all save/progression conditions enabling each story entrance are not yet fully reconstructed

eventContracts.unloadEntry: BP_CityManager.UnloadBossLevel(BossType), guarded by first BP_BaseBoss being valid
eventContracts.unknown: automatic boss event scheduling/threshold timing upstream in HeroGameState is not fully contracted; do not spawn all bosses on initial load

eventContracts.transition: Unload DynamicProps then latent completion at 2314 reloads it; not permanent district eviction

triggerContracts.mainOverlapEffect: SetStartMassageTypeAndStoryType(0,0); show CQ panel and publish CQSetting(self); no LoadStreamLevel here
triggerContracts.exitEffect: SetStartMassageTypeAndStoryType(3,0); hide CQ panel when GameInputState in [0,4]; CQSetting(null)
triggerContracts.tutorialSphereBeginContract: If GameMode.InTutorial, NOT OverlapEffect, P_QuestArea1.IsActive, and OtherActor has Player tag: deactivate P_QuestArea1; OverlapEffect=true. No level load on this begin-overlap path.
triggerContracts.tutorialSphereUnknown: remaining tutorial end-overlap and progression effects are not fully contracted

triggerContracts.effect: SetStartMassageTypeAndStoryType(IsSotryClear ? 2 : 1, StoryType) and show prompt. No direct streaming call.
triggerContracts.interactionDispatch: PlayerBP StartMassageType=1 calls StoryManager.StartStory(StoryType); type=2 calls BossSpawn using StoryType 1->0,2->1,3->2
triggerContracts.unknown: input action key and complete outer input guard not re-traced in this bounded streaming contract; overlap activation also depends on story progression

unknowns: No original runtime load completion/visibility trace; latent requests can fail or be superseded.
Dynamic objects omit initial loaded/visible properties. Omission alone is not used to infer current visibility.
AlwaysLoaded title level is resident, but title actors can be hidden by TitleOptions interface; not all level actors render simultaneously.
Actor construction/BeginPlay scripts can alter visibility, collision, effects and transforms beyond package selection.
Some CQ/Boss selector entries name packages absent from the 41 shipped /Game maps; use shippedPackageExists and do not invent replacement maps.
Nested Lighting sublevel references are preserved separately; no invented recursive always-load behavior.
No position-driven district streaming was found in the decoded call/volume scan; this does not prove absence of all native/custom behavior.
